contracts.order: Actual Assassin result/reaction -> one equal Assassin Type spin -> register Speed+1 and grant exactly its one linked reward atomically -> actual subtype/grant reaction -> Backstory.
contracts.probability: All six types accepted; each baseWeight1 and ordinary probability1/6. Rewards/power tiers do not introduce rarity or a category wheel. Retain authorized eligibility/distribution policies.
contracts.reward: Apply only the selected recipe: +1 numeric Speed plus one power OR one weapon, never both. Fixed grant is not a power/weapon acquisition draw and adds no extra subtype/rarity/success/count wheel.
contracts.speed: Register a source-owned +1 Speed ledger once at the committed subtype result. Calculate only during final bonus phase from immutable retained raw stat plus distinct active modifiers; do not increase current raw score or roll a stat here.
contracts.power: Each power is ordinary recipient-owned Tier3/4 with one shared character Power Mastery later, retained after normal Power None. No mastery boost, God Authority maximum or power Enchant. Tier is intrinsic and independent of mastery.
contracts.weapon: One weapon instance from its exact definition, with normal per-active-weapon mastery later and final compatible effective-Master5+ Enchant. Normal main Weapon acquisition remains scheduled. Respect existing central inventory guards; a blocked weapon gives no reroll or guessed replacement and does not cancel Speed+1.
contracts.historyVsMechanics: Historical sources provide context only. Exact game power/weapon recipes are authored fantasy adaptations authorized by this reward brief, not factual claims about real groups. Do not dispatch historical hero/race/group events.
contracts.ledger: Freeze Assassin rule/version, actual pool/odds, subtype, selected recipe and canonical definition/tier metadata. Stable source key runId/sourceArchetypeInvocationId/sourceAssassinTypeSpinId/eventProfileId; atomic commit once, replay/media retries reuse grants/modifier without another draw or duplicate inventory.
contracts.context: Stack actual selected type, acquired reward and pending numeric Speed bonus with provenance. At reaction time do not reveal future stat/mastery/Backstory. Short captions create no implicit funny-result tag or Shrek trigger.
contracts.return: Restore Backstory after the one subtype child transaction/reaction. Preserve all earlier source-owned rewards and the approved stage order.
contracts.existingPolicies: Preserve accepted Archetype eligibility, global owned-race exclusions, one Size, shared Power Mastery and final bonus/Enchant timing. Type selection is not an owned-race draw and changes no race history.
contracts.runtime: Core event design approved; final body-role fit, intrinsic capability/equipment profiles and runtime executor remain configuration. Whole Archetype roster is not automatically active.
contracts.migration: Old draft/frozen results remain unchanged under reference/before-assassin-rewards-2026-10-10.json; new invocations use assassin/0.2.0. Do not retroactively grant rewards to old journals.
contracts.recipeAuthority: Execute the selected rewardProfiles entry once: its statModifiers list and its one grant are the sole reward instructions. Other display/profile metadata never dispatch a duplicate reward.
